description: The tutor client's fields of an answer: merge these properties into the answer schema of the app's grind. Every one is optional.

asks.description: Names of facts on the catalogue (is fact) that you need before you can answer well. The app reads them and sends the request again with them as asked; ask once, for everything you need.

do.description: Commands on the catalogue (is command) to run, in order, each with the args its entry describes. Only what he asked for.

name.description: The name of a command on the catalogue.

args.description: The args as that command's entry describes them; leave out when it takes none.

go.description: The place on the catalogue (is place) to open, with the args its entry describes. At most one.

name.description: The name of a place on the catalogue.

args.description: The args as that place's entry describes them; leave out when it takes none.

misses.description: What he wanted, or you needed, that the catalogue has no fact, command or place for.

wanted.description: In a few words, what was missing.

why.description: What was in the way: which fact, command or place the catalogue lacks.

said.description: One plain sentence on what you did through the app, or what you asked of him. Leave it out when you did nothing through the app.
